title: Rekey replacement can resurrect a previously retired compromised identity
description: Security review: replacement preflight ignores retired identities and rotation explicitly removes the replacement from retired history. After A→B, B→A or absent-old→A can restore a retired key once live tables are gone. Retired/history identities must remain ineligible without an explicit higher-assurance recovery protocol; persist monotonic lineage and test A→B→A/absent-old rejection with no mutation.
